entries.title: Whole Stepped Columnar Joint Rock Escarpment
entries.description: One independently authored whole stylized columnar-joint rock escarpment. A continuous irregular low rock apron carries tightly packed complete polygonal shafts with genuinely separated deep longitudinal joint faces, small coherent sidewall kinks and staggered broken top elevations. The low front cells rise through a middle band into a high rear crown, making one stepped cliff mass rather than scattered rocks, a pillar-count variant or a colour replacement. All numeric geometry new; no old wall, terrain or mineral mesh imported. One complete terrain prop zero scenes, four matte opaque rock PBR roles. Fixed artistic visual form only: no geological formation, exact basalt crystallography, age, climbing, navigation, collision, stability or engineering safety claim. No plants, water, lava effects, rigging or animation.

entries.title: Whole Empty Trough and Cargo Cycle Parking Bay
entries.description: One static public cycle parking and service-equipment bay, one scene and zero new independent models. Three complete qualified originals retain all geometry buffers, normals, opaque PBR, internal hierarchy and original unit scale: an empty lowered-upper-trough two-level rack occupies the left position, a whole low-front-bay cargo bicycle stands independently on its own two tires and deployed feet to the right, and an entire cycle-service post occupies a separate rear position. The rack stays completely empty: the bicycle is not inserted, leaned on it or claimed compatible with either trough. All original empty cargo bay, steering-link exterior, hose and parked nozzle remain untouched. An open foreground joins the separately grounded positions. Unlike the old empty twin-hoop/barrier parking corner or the table-fixture and suspended bicycle repair bay, this shows independent parked cargo transport next to empty two-level parking equipment without a clamp or maintenance workbench. Only whole translations and a finite scene-only paving slab are new. No people, cargo, actual pumping, bicycle fitting, parking operation, security, access compliance, circulation safety, engineering installation or load claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Cutaway Channel and Unequal Upright Chamber Pump
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete hydraulic-ram-pump-inspired dry static display. A single continuous thick low horizontal shell retains a true through channel, a deliberate longitudinal front inspection cut and two independent upper openings. One short open-top chamber on the left contains a complete annular seat and separate fixed raised blunt disk/stem, held by two external guide posts and a small cross bridge. A separate much taller complete hollow closed-domed vessel rises over the right opening; both belong to the same common manifold on two whole broad feet. Whole open annular inlet and terminal connectors complete the single apparatus. No old visible meshes imported. Unlike the old one-seat spring-poppet valve, there is no tall exposed coil or adjusting bonnet above a single right-angle chamber; unlike the opposed drum pump there is no symmetric horizontal drum pair, central drive body or upper/lower bridging loops. New asymmetric short-open-valve and tall-domed-vessel organization over one common channel, not a colored old pump or an added loose tank counted separately. Four opaque constant PBR appearances, metre-style native Z-up and whole horizontal envelope centred over the foot soles; one model zero scenes. Dimensions and cross-section are simplified illustrative artwork, not an engineering design or construction instructions. No fluid, air charge, pressure, valve actuation, sealing, fit, pump cycle, flow continuity, hydraulic operation, performance, capacity, manufacture, installation, load, balance or equipment safety is made or verified. Rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Whole Open Tailgate Round Chamber and Pickup Baler
entries.description: One independently authored whole empty towable round-baler-inspired apparatus in a fixed display pose. A full low twin-wheel frame and converging draw beams support a thick front semicylindrical chamber, complete side cheeks and a full rear curved shell raised about an upper cross pin. Its real empty curved inside and lower rollers are exposed rather than a black disc or enclosed bale. A separate low horizontal pickup drum with complete support cheeks and blunt comb teeth sits under a whole shallow front visor. This is not the old rectangular long-hand-lever press reshaped or a combine with its cab deleted: all visible geometry is newly authored for this complete low front pickup/large round rear chamber/raised curved tailgate relationship. One model zero scenes, four opaque matte PBR materials. No crop or bale. Static visual exterior only: no gathering, feed path, compaction, bale formation, power, towing, articulation, hydraulic motion, manufacture, load, human fit or agricultural safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Whole Floor Roll Press and Empty Preparation Bench
entries.description: One static printmaking-equipment preparation bay, one scene and zero new independent models. Four complete qualified originals retain their raw geometry buffers, normals, full opaque PBR dictionaries, hierarchy and unit scale. A whole floor-standing twin-roll long-traverse-bed press occupies the rear-left, its entire blank bed, star wheel and both shoes intact. A separate complete open worktable stands forward-right and supports the entire grinding-slab and muller set on the left and the whole horizontal double-fork brayer on the right, separated by visible tabletop. No ink, pigment, paper, chemical preparation, print transfer, machine operation, roller pressure, bed travel, equipment compatibility, ergonomic compliance, load rating or workplace safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Overpass And Four Curved Connector Ramps
entries.description: One newly authored static grade-separated road junction miniature module. A complete elevated straight bridge crosses one complete perpendicular lower road with an open underpass. Four continuous thick quarter-curve graded branch decks occupy the four quadrants, each joining an upper-road side mouth to a lower-road side mouth; not two unconnected roads merely stacked. Complete curb strips leave the eight branch mouths open. Two bridge piers and four independent ramp piers connect the decks to one whole grounded plinth. New geometry throughout, not rescaled existing roads or imported culvert pieces. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z-up, centred bounds and grounded datum. One complete static model zero scenes. No vehicle, lane markings, traffic circulation rules, road-network compatibility, verified driving surface, accessibility, turning radius, gradient suitability, clearance, loading, drainage, construction or engineering safety capability. No animation or interaction made.

entries.title: Whole Offset Basin and Empty Hand Bay Station
entries.description: One empty public wash-and-dry equipment preparation point, one scene zero new independent models. A separate entire original opposed-shoulder hand-bay appliance stands forward-right with its real top-open and side-open deep bay unchanged. The two whole grounded stations face a shared empty front floor and have a positive lateral interval, rather than being fitted into one continuous countertop. entries.title: Whole Fin Tip Rocket and Open Well Platform
entries.description: One static fictional non-weapon space-display scene, one scene and zero new independent models. All four whole fin-tip sole patches sit on the actual upper field outside the square central well; the original downward-open blind decorative bell is above that well with a visible fixed vertical gap. The complete original side approach and low front outlet remain present and empty. One finite scene-only apron supports both the original full plinth sole and whole ramp sole. Original rocket body, fins and blind bell are not extracted, resized, posed or rebuilt; the platform, turning inner void, full side ramp and per-face markings are unchanged. Both complete original GLBs retain all raw vertex, index and normal payload bytes, local transforms and full material dictionaries, only whole parent translations are added. This mounted four-tip/annular-field relation differs from the old separate landing-platform and offset access-lift court and from the junction/solar-array/rover forecourt. No new tower, launcher, engine, flame, fuel, vehicle, boarding mechanism or repeated model is counted. Empty static artistic arrangement only. All original limitations remain. Rigging animation and interaction are not made.

entries.title: Whole Long Apron Box and Rear Vertical Drum Spreader
entries.description: One independently authored complete empty rear-drum agricultural spreader-trailer appearance. Beyond that opening a full-height independent bearing gate supports two complete vertical drums, each with a continuous thick blunt helical vane; lower and upper beams join the whole frame. The long apron-box-to-rear-upright-drum relationship differs from the existing hand-push round funnel and horizontal spinner underneath, and from the compact closed-back cargo tub. All visible coordinates are new, not old trailer geometry with extra cargo or a copied auger. One model zero scenes, four opaque PBR materials, no contents. Static fixed artistic exterior only: no conveying, manure/fertilizer compatibility, throwing, drive, flow, coverage, rotation, coupling fit, towing, load, handling, manufacture or safety performance.
